Bambu Bar — Third-Party Open-Source Notices
=============================================

1. Sparkle (Direct macOS edition)
   URL: https://sparkle-project.org
   License: MIT License (full text in Sparkle-LICENSE.txt)
   Used for signed, EdDSA-verified in-app updates in the direct Developer ID edition.

2. ha-bambulab (Protocol & HMS catalog reference)
   URL: https://github.com/greghesp/ha-bambulab
   License: MIT License
   Protocol documentation and HMS error message references informed Bambu Bar's
   local-network printer report parsing and HMS error catalog.

3. Community Protocol Documentation
   - Bambuddy: community documentation of newer printer telemetry fields.
   - bambu-cli: community documentation of LAN printer commands and model fields.
   - Bambu Studio printer profiles: publicly distributed capability definitions
     (chamber sensors, fans, heated chambers, nozzles, and build volumes).
